item.title: Monaghan to Ballybay Road closed due to collision
item.description: The R162 road between Monaghan and Ballybay is closed following a single road vehicle collision involving a truck. The incident occurred in the townland of Annamacneill. According to Gardai the incident is not serious, however the road will be closed for a short time to facilitate the removal of the truck involved. Advertisement Motorists are advised to avoid the area at this time.

item.description: A dedicated Garda unit's been established to deal with Troubles related investigations. The Minister for Justice has announced the setting up of the Garda Troubles Legacy Liaison Unit. Jim O' Callaghan says it's a significant milestone in the implementation of the Joint Framework agreed with the British government. item.title: Plans lodged for children's respite centre in Monaghan
item.description: The HSE has applied for planning permission for the construction of a new, state of the art children's respite centre in Monaghan. HSE bosses have now lodged plans with Monaghan County Council to knock an existing vacant house at Drumbear and Killygowan and develop a purpose built facility in its place. item.title: Exhibition underway in Virginia surrounding LGBT+ parenthood
item.description: A exhibition that centres on the themes of family law and LGBT+ parenthood is currently on display in Virginia. The exhibition features a compelling series of photographs accompanied by a companion book. The book entitled 'Family Law' was written by Sarah-Jane Travers with photographs by her brother-in-law Ciarán Dunbar. item.title: Local ballad group to compete in Scór All-Ireland
item.description: A ballad group from the Sean McDermotts GAA club in Co Monaghan will represent Ulster this weekend at the Scór All -Ireland finals in Killarney. The club which is based in Threemilehouse has a rich history with Scór and has had major success on a number of occasions down through the years. The group which comprises of members Eimear Beagan, Katie Brabazon, Cianna McCormack, Roisin Murphy and Zara Drum secured victory in both the county and provincial finals. item.title: Defibrillator cabinet moves location in Ballybay
item.description: Cllr Sinead Flynn is calling for local first responders to be aware that the location of the defibrillator cabinet in Ballybay has changed. According to Cllr Flynn, the defibrillator cabinet at the Old Library in Ballybay was accidently damaged. For this reason, the defibrillator was moved today to Smyth's Newsagent, Ballybay until further notice and will be available to the public during normal opening hours. item.title: Works continue to fix burst water main in Ballyjamesduff
item.description: Uisce Éireann crews continue to work to repair a burst water main outside Ballyjamesduff this evening. Repairs are proving to be complex with difficulty gaining access to the burst water main on the Virginia Road leading out of the town. Available reservoir supplies are being used to supply the town while repairs are ongoing but some Uisce Éireann customers in Ballyjamesduff may be experiencing intermittent supply or reduced pressure this evening as a result of this burst. item.title: Appeal issued for missing Monaghan teenager
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for the public's assistance in tracing the whereabouts of Chloe Lawrence (17), who was reported missing from Emyvale, Co. Monaghan since Wednesday 21st January 2026. It is believed that Chloe travelled to north Dublin. She is described as being 5 feet 4 inches tall, with a slim build, light brown hair, and blue eyes. Advertisement Anyone with information on Chloe's whereabouts is asked to contact Monaghan Garda Station at 047 77200, the Garda Confidential Line at 1800 666 11

item.title: Urgent appeal issued over missing Arva teen
item.description: Gardaí are seeking the public’s assistance in tracing the whereabouts of Lucy Cawley (15) who was reported missing from Arva, Co Cavan, since Friday 23rd January 2026. Lucy is described as being approximately 5 foot 4 inches in height, of slim build with blonde hair and blue eyes. She was last seen in Longford Town wearing grey sweatpants, a white hoodie and white runners. Advertisement Gardaí are concerned for Lucy’s well-being.
